objective: Maximize the probability of at least one COMPLETE Any Order (Box) winning digit multiset across exactly three distinct eligible tickets per drawing. No partial digits or positional matches count.

live_champion.status: deployed, no verified real predictive edge

experiments.name: pooled_full_box_v2
experiments.hypothesis: Individual-digit pooled probabilities improve ranking of complete multisets
experiments.decision: Fixes duplicate permutation tickets but does not beat fair controls reliably

experiments.name: day_night_conditional_box_v1
experiments.hypothesis: Earlier same-day Day numbers help infer later Night outcomes
experiments.real_test: 804 previously inspected Night draws per game
experiments.note: No active confirmed conditional expert; Pick3 favorable count was fair-fallback luck, not a model-driven win

experiments.name: bayesian_exact_bag_v1
experiments.hypothesis: Anomalies occur at the complete unordered multiset level, beyond marginal digit frequencies
experiments.decision: Strongly detects artificial 5% favored exact combination but overfits actual fair-like historical draws; do not retune these same inspected years

experiments.name: bayesian_pair_shape_v1
experiments.hypothesis: Digit pair co-occurrence creates predictive full-ticket dependency beyond marginal frequencies
experiments.decision: No credible real full Box lift; do not rescue with posterior-strength tuning on inspected 2025/2026 archive

permanent_validation_rules: Every evaluated target and ticket selection must be fixed using only information available before the exact original drawing.
Primary metric is at least one correct full unordered digit MULTISET across three distinct, equally priced Any Order Box tickets; repeated permutations of one set do not increase coverage.
Use an independent random baseline with the same ticket count, and report fair expected hit count, proper joint Box probability log score, and uncertainty.
Archived 2025/2026 draws and the synthetic patterns have been inspected and cannot be promoted as untouched evidence; no repeated rescue tuning on a burned holdout.
A new version is not superior merely because its unit tests pass or because it learns deliberately injected simulator patterns.

No production promotion until future-only immutable real predictions demonstrate repeatable calibrated probability improvement AND incremental full Box wins versus equal-cost fair controls, after model-selection multiplicity.
If fair-null behavior survives all justified tests, maintain maximal distinct-coverage fair fallback and do not invent predictive precision.
open_data_dependency: Pre-draw and draw-by-draw machine/ball-set IDs and pretest results are not present in ordinary historical digit downloads; availability before wager cutoff has NOT been established. Do not assume access or use simulator secrets.
follow_up_trigger: Reopen model research for genuinely new legally available pre-wager explanatory variables, a distinct structural prediction mechanism not chosen from inspected real data, or a statistically meaningful prospective anomaly; do not cycle variants of frozen failures.
